LanguageData.EF_Alert_WrongBloodlineDesc:
These colonists are using entads bound to another bloodline. The items work as ordinary items, but their entad traits do nothing for them:
{0}
LanguageData.EF_Card_BoundDesc: This entad is bound. Anyone can use it as an ordinary item, but its traits only work for the pawns it is bound to and their descendants. Its durability, value and effects on a building apply regardless.
LanguageData.EF_Card_InactiveFor: Its traits do nothing for {0}, who is not of a bound bloodline.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_DamageTypeDesc: {0}: this weapon's attacks deal {1} damage instead of their usual type.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_ExtraDamageDesc: {0}: each hit deals this much additional {1} damage, on top of the weapon's normal damage. It is not reduced by or added to the Damage stat above.
LanguageData.EF_Stat_ExtraTotalDesc: Total additional damage, of other damage types, dealt with every hit by this weapon's entad traits.
LanguageData.EF_AbilityUnknown: The effect of this ability is not yet known.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Reset_Tip: Resets the General and Rarity and durability tabs. Which traits are enabled is left as it is.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_HideTraits_Tip: Newly generated entad items show "???" for their traits until something the trait affects happens. Existing items keep their current state.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_WeaponWeight_Desc: How much more likely traits made for weapons (damage, accuracy, ...) are than general ones when generating for a weapon. 1 = no preference.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_RarityCurve_Desc: Relative chance of each rarity when a trait is picked. Rarities with no eligible trait are skipped and the rest are renormalised.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Multipliers_Desc: How much a rarity widens the min/max of traits that scale with rarity. Offsets are multiplied; factors scale their distance from 100%. A trait is capped at the highest rarity where its values stay valid (for example a factor never drops to zero).
LanguageData.EF_Settings_Durability_Desc: Max hit points multiplier for every item with at least one entad trait, set by the highest rarity among its traits.
LanguageData.EF_Settings_TraitCounts: {0} of {1} traits shown, {2} disabled. Disabled traits are never picked when generating items.
